name: action-atoms
title: Actions
description: Small Tailwind-first action atoms for buttons, toggles, grouping, and reorder affordances.
useWhen: You need a small semantic action that will become part of a larger control or toolbar.
avoidWhen: The interaction requires a complete menu, dialog, or multi-step state machine.
responsiveBehavior: Action atoms preserve touch-friendly hit areas and wrap only when composed by a parent.
accessibility: Uses native button and anchor semantics.
Provides visible focus styles and accessible labels for icon-only actions.

variants.title: Button
variants.description: A compact primary button with native semantics, focus treatment, and disabled styling.
accessibility: Keep disabled actions out of keyboard interaction.

variants.title: Icon Button
variants.description: A square icon action with a minimum hit area and a required accessible name.

variants.title: Link Button
variants.description: A link styled as a lightweight action for navigation rather than mutation.
accessibility: Use an anchor when the action changes location.

variants.title: Close Button
variants.description: A quiet icon-only close action with an explicit accessible name.
accessibility: Expose the action as Close to assistive technology.

variants.title: Toggle Button
variants.description: A two-state button that exposes its pressed state to assistive technology.

variants.title: Button Group
variants.description: A semantic group that keeps adjacent actions visually connected.
accessibility: Use the group role only for a meaningful related set.

variants.title: Drag Handle
variants.description: A focused reorder affordance with a grab cursor and a clear accessible label.
accessibility: Provide a label explaining the reorder action.
Pair with keyboard reorder controls in a complete component.
